title: Create a Brand Profile for your TTO account
content_data:
Use this endpoint to create a Brand Profile for your TikTok One (TTO) Creator Marketplace account. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tto/tcm/brand/profile/create/ **Method** POST **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Access token authorized by a TTO Creator Marketplace account.
For details, see [Authentication](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/obtain-authorization-and-authentication-from-a-tto-creator-marketplace-account/v1.3).| |Content-Type {Required}|string|Request message type.
Allowed format: `application/json`. | ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | | tto_tcm_account_id {Required} | string | The ID of the TTO Creator Marketplace account.

To obtain the IDs of the accounts that you can access via `Access-Token`, use [/tto/oauth2/tcm/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1815693478150146). | | brand_name {Required} | string | Brand name.

Length limit: 60 characters.

Note: Once set, this field cannot be updated. | | brand_industry_id {Required} | string | The ID of the brand industry.

For enum values, see [Brand Profile industry IDs](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1830336456075458).

Note: Once set, this field cannot be updated. | | brand_website {Required} | string | Brand website link.

The link should start with `https://`. | | logo_url {Required} | string | The URL of the brand logo image.

Specification requirements:

  • File format: JPG, PNG, or GIF.
  • Aspect ratio: 1:1.
  • File size: Up to 5MB.

Note: Once set, this field cannot be updated. | |tiktok_account_url|string|The URL of your TikTok account.

The URL should start with `https://www.tiktok.com/@`.

If you provide this URL when creating a Brand Profile, creators can view your linked account directly on your profile. This improves brand authenticity and transparency before you collaborate.

To find the URL of your TikTok account, navigate to your TikTok profile, click the Share button, and copy the link.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tto/tcm/brand/profile/create/' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{ "tto_tcm_account_id": "{{tto_tcm_account_id}}", "brand_name": "{{brand_name}}", "brand_website": "{{brand_website}}", "brand_industry_id": "290101", "logo_url": "{{logo_url}}" }' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.| #|brand_profile_id | string | The ID of the created Brand Profile. | #|brand_name | string | Brand name. | #|brand_industry_id | string | The ID of the brand industry. | #|brand_website | string | Brand website link. | #|logo_url | string | The URL of the brand logo image for your TTO Creator Marketplace account.

Note: This URL is system-generated for the logo image and is different from the URL specified through `logo_url` in the request for Brand Profile creation. | #|tiktok_account_url|string|The URL of your TikTok account.

If no TikTok account URL is provided for creating the Brand Profile, this field will be an empty string (`""`).| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "brand_industry_id": "290101", "brand_name": "{{brand_name}}", "brand_profile_id": "{{brand_profile_id}}", "brand_website": "{{brand_website}}", "logo_url": "{{logo_url}}" } } (/code) ```
